title: Theo and the Deadline
author: Odile Dravenmoor
blurb: Elodie Crane, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
